response.query: How will the automatic cost-model define numeric switching thresholds for low-rank SSM vs full SSM or sparse attention, and what experiments will validate them across GPU models and graph scales?
response.answer: Automatic cost-model defines numeric switching thresholds based on computational efficiency and resource usage across GPU models and graph scales. Experiments validate these thresholds through performance benchmarks and scalability tests. Thresholds are adjusted for low-rank SSM vs full SSM or sparse attention.
